description: Dataconto's rights check: from who can sign, customer contracts, personal data, staff and contractor IP and the tools the company uses, a verdict (ready = nothing in the way, work = steps to finish before signing, not_yet = nobody known who can sign for a closing or closed company) and the steps, each with its level (block, work, note, ok) and the Dataconto page that holds its source. Unanswered questions count as not sure and are listed in `missing`. With tools, also returns what each tool's terms say on ownership, export and AI training, each quote dated. Sums up published sources; not legal advice. Tool ids as in get_tool_terms.

contracts.description: Whether any customer contracts limit what the company can do with their data.

ip.description: Whether staff and contractor agreements assign their work to the company. gaps = not all of them; na = no documents or code in scope.

personal.description: Personal data in the records. regulated = health or financial records.

signer.description: Who can sign for the company now. officer = a director or officer; officeholder = an administrator, liquidator or trustee.

tools.description: Tool ids the company uses, e.g. ["slack", "notion"].

name: rights_check
title: Check whether a company's records are ready to license
